# Coin launch art kit

**Token image, launch card, banner and announcement visuals for a Solana or Robinhood Chain launch, with no price promises.**

Builds every visual a Claudia coin launch needs, in one consistent kit — the token image (the permanent coin logo and the coin's avatar, sized for pump.fun on Solana and the Robinhood Chain launchpads Pons, Pools, Flap, Bags, Clanker and Dyor), the launch card from launchCardPrompt in @useclaudia/media, a 3:1 banner for the coin's X header, and announcement visuals (X image, 9:16 clip, Telegram pin) with AI labels, alt text and "not financial advice" — then hands the image to `claudia launch --image`, the SDK's uploadImage or the MCP prepare_launch tool. Use when someone is about to launch a coin and needs a logo, token image, launch card, banner or announcement art, or asks "what image do I need for pump.fun". Never puts prices, rising charts, rockets or promises on any image.

## How it works

1. Fill the art brief
2. Save a brand kit for the coin
3. Make the token image
4. Export the token image to spec
5. Make the launch card
6. Make the banner
7. Make the announcement visuals
8. Run the red-line review
9. Hand off to the launch

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/coin-launch-art-kit.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/coin-launch-art-kit.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/coin-launch-art-kit.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/coin-launch-art-kit.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill coin-launch-art-kit`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `coin-launch-art-kit.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/coin-launch-art-kit`.
